functions.name: list_sessions_v2
functions.description: List sessions with pre-aggregated summary data. Returns no_results with fuzzy suggestions if location not found. Sessions have start_date and end_date (multi-day sessions supported). Date filtering uses overlap logic.

user_id.description: User UUID from current_user_id session attribute. Always pass this when available.

search_by.description: JSON string with field:value pairs. Available fields: location (partial match), format (partial match, e.g. expo, shop, party, phone, in-person), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD, overlap filter), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, overlap filter), day_of_week (sunday|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday - derived from Reading_Timestamp), session_duration_days (integer, e.g. 3 for 3-day events)

limit.description: Max sessions to return. Omit to get all.

functions.name: list_readings_v2
functions.description: List individual readings with full session context. Returns no_results with fuzzy suggestions if location not found. Readings include reading_date derived from Reading_Timestamp (local clock time).

user_id.description: User UUID from current_user_id session attribute. Always pass this when available.

search_by.description: JSON string with field:value pairs. Available fields: location (partial match), payment (cash, cc, venmo, paypal, cashapp), source (referral, renu, pog, repeat), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD, filters on reading_date), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, filters on reading_date), min_tip (number), max_tip (number), time_of_day (morning|afternoon|evening), day_of_week (sunday|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday), session_duration_days (integer)

limit.description: Max readings to return. Omit to get all.

functions.name: get_session_details_v2
functions.description: Get complete session with all readings and summary stats in one call.

functions.name: get_user_summary_v2
functions.description: Get aggregate statistics for a user across all sessions. Returns totals, averages, and locations list.

user_id.description: User UUID from current_user_id session attribute. Always pass this when available.
